# Security & Authorization Requirements Checklist: Profile

**Purpose**: Validate that entry R4's security, authorization and credential-adjacent requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent and objectively verifiable — before tasks are cut against them
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Graded against**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md) and [contracts/](../contracts/).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what makes an avatar value "well-formed" beyond its scheme — in particular whether a host component is required for a value to be accepted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Is the request-origin assertion that both server entry points perform stated as a requirement anywhere in the spec, or does it exist only in the design? [Gap, contracts/update-own-profile.md step 1, contracts/change-password-link.md step 1]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the mutator's behaviour when the session resolves to an account deactivated after the page rendered? [Gap — Spec §US2 scenario 7 covers the route request only]
- [x] CHK004 Is the set of columns the mutator must never write stated as closed and exhaustive, or as four named examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021 vs data-model.md §3]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the address-independent half of the reset rate limit as it applies to this link, or only the per-address half? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK006 Does any requirement establish that no writer other than this screen can set an avatar value, given SC-010 asserts a property of every value the system stores? [Gap, Spec §SC-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for the referrer posture of the third-party image an avatar URL names? [Gap, research.md *Assumptions carried forward* 3]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for how a password-accepting control would be recognised — what boundary "this screen" draws for FR-027's negative proof? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK009 Is the avatar scheme comparison specified as case-insensitive, so an uppercase scheme has a defined outcome rather than an implied one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Is "a generic message" quantified for a failed write, given FR-029 fixes exact wording for the successful press? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023 vs §FR-029]
- [x] CHK011 Is the format of "the time remaining" in a throttle refusal specified — unit, rounding, and whether it is stated to the second? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is "whether it arrives from the screen or directly" defined precisely enough to be an acceptance condition — what caller does "directly" name? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK013 Can "no control on this screen accepts a password" be evaluated against a stated file, route or component boundary? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK014 Is "the row the session resolves to" defined for a mutation with no resolvable session, as distinct from a page request with none? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019 vs §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do FR-021's four named columns and the data model's "and every other column on the row" express the same obligation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, data-model.md §3]
- [x] CHK016 Is the refusal for a field name outside the seven required by the spec, or introduced by the contract without a requirement behind it? [Consistency, contracts/update-own-profile.md *Refusals* vs Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK017 Are the authorization requirements for the two server entry points stated on the same terms — both self-only, both session-derived, neither gated by a role predicate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK018 Does the requirement that a refused press cannot block a sign-in sit consistently with the requirement that every press records an attempt? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, contracts/change-password-link.md step 5]
- [x] CHK019 Are the requirements that keep a role off this screen consistent between the screen's rendering rules and the mutator's write rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, §FR-025, §FR-021]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a change-password press by a user deactivated between page render and press? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the outcome when mail sending fails after the attempt row and the token have already been written? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/change-password-link.md]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements specified for concurrent saves of the same field from two sessions of the same user? [Coverage, Gap — Spec §Edge Cases covers two different fields only]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for what reaches the caller when a value passes the parser but violates a database constraint? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, data-model.md §4]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Is the premise that the credential-entry-point index omits Profile recorded where a reviewer can evaluate it without leaving the spec? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, contracts/change-password-link.md]
- [x] CHK025 Are the security properties this feature merely observes distinguished, item by item, from those it must itself enforce? [Clarity, contracts/change-password-link.md *What happens after the press, and who owns it*]
- [x] CHK026 Is the separation of the reset counter from the sign-in counter stated as this feature's obligation or as an inherited property it relies on? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK027 Does any requirement state whether an avatar value stored before this rule existed must be re-validated when rendered? [Gap, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK028 Is the negative-and-directional reading of the password-policy obligation stated in terms a reviewer could disagree with and resolve, rather than asserted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file; each domain checklist numbers independently
